text: Never mind, I’ve broke a hole.” He reached his hand in and drew it out— “Man, it’s money!” The two men examined the handful of coins. They were gold. The boys above were as excited as themselves, and as delighted. Joe’s comrade said: “We’ll make quick work of this. There’s an old rusty pick over amongst the weeds in the corner the other side of the fireplace—I saw it a minute ago.” He ran and brought the boys’ pick and shovel.
